proofs.verified_behavior: After Cursor::get_ref, AsRef::as_ref, Cursor::position, and u64-to-usize conversion return the supplied values, Buf::remaining returns saturating_sub(slice length, converted position).
assumptions: AsRef::as_ref on inner returns slice s

proofs.verified_behavior: When the position converts to usize and is at or beyond the referenced slice length, Buf::remaining returns zero.
assumptions: Cursor::get_ref returns inner and AsRef::as_ref returns slice s
Cursor::position returns position and TryFrom<u64> converts it to positionUsize

proofs.verified_behavior: When the cursor position cannot be represented as usize, Buf::remaining returns zero.
assumptions: Cursor::get_ref returns inner and AsRef::as_ref returns slice s
TryFrom<u64> for position returns an error

proofs.verified_behavior: When the position converts to usize, Buf::chunk returns the referenced slice suffix starting at min(position, slice length); the start is proven in bounds.
assumptions: Cursor::get_ref returns inner and AsRef::as_ref returns slice s

proofs.verified_behavior: When the cursor position cannot be represented as usize, Buf::chunk returns the empty suffix at the end of the referenced slice.
assumptions: Cursor::get_ref returns inner and AsRef::as_ref returns slice s
TryFrom<u64> for position returns an error
